session_result.boundary_note: OBSERVE_ONLY: authenticated read-only Kalshi market-data observation. The session sends channel subscriptions only, over a closed allowlist ('orderbook_delta', 'ticker', 'trade', 'market_lifecycle_v2'); no order, position, wallet, key-management or write-scoped surface exists in this package.
